cases.name: hitxy_cadence_window
cases.delphi_rule: GetTickCount - LatestHitTime >= 900 - HitSpeed*60; early attempts increment HitTimeOverCount/HitTimeOverSum and remain allowed while <4 and <6.

cases.name: spellxy_cooldown
cases.delphi_rule: DoSpell deducts MP and broadcasts SM_SPELL before SpellNow branch failures decide effect/fire packets.

cases.name: attack_longhit_dual_target_chain
cases.delphi_rule: SwordLongAttack applies the range-2 DirectAttack path and the normal front-target path when both targets exist.

cases.name: attack_widehit_order
cases.delphi_rule: SwordWideAttack uses Delphi valarr order and no damage falloff.

cases.name: attack_crosshit_order
cases.delphi_rule: CrossHit uses the frozen Delphi target order and applies 80% damage for PvP targets.

cases.name: pk_target_rules
cases.delphi_rule: IsProperTarget and CheckAttackRule2 decide HAM_ALL/HAM_PEACE/HAM_GROUP/HAM_GUILD/HAM_PKATTACK plus safety and ownership guards.

cases.name: struck_delay_200_500
cases.delphi_rule: Main-target visible SM_STRUCK is delayed 200ms; DirectAttack visible SM_STRUCK is delayed 500ms; monster internal RM_STRUCK is immediate and not socket-visible.

cases.name: death_revival_packet_order
cases.delphi_rule: Damage, revival decision, death/drop settlement, and SM_STRUCK/SM_DEATH/SM_NOWDEATH order must be fixed from Delphi traces.

cases.name: hit_rng_sword4_heavy_big
cases.delphi_rule: Hit check is Random(SpeedPoint) < AccuracyPoint; skill 4 participates in sword-skill chains; HeavyHit/BigHit do not carry unproven modern damage multipliers.
